rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something strikingly weird or bizarre.

example.english: They were wearing a dinosaur costume on the street—it was truly bizarre.
example.traditional: 佢竟然喺街上面着住件恐龍裝，真係古怪。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ging2 jin4 hai2 gaai1 soeng6 min6 zoek6 zyu6 gin6 hung2 lung4 zong1 zan1 hai6 gu2 gwaai3

rows.note: Use this for something unusually strange, especially when expressing surprise or puzzlement.

example.english: Bizarre—why did the fridge open by itself?
example.traditional: 奇怪喎，部雪櫃點解會自己開咗？
example.jyutping: kei4 gwaai3 wo3 bou6 syut3 gwai6 dim2 gaai2 wui5 zi6 gei2 hoi1 zo2

rows.note: Use this mainly for bizarre events, stories, or incidents that seem inexplicable.

example.english: This burglary case is truly bizarre; the CCTV did not capture anyone at all.
example.traditional: 呢宗失竊案真係離奇，閉路電視完全影唔到人。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 sat1 sit3 on3 zan1 hai6 lei4 kei4 bai3 lou6 din6 si6 jyun4 cyun4 jing2 m4 dou2 jan4
